name: Criteria 1
text: A tool whose output is part of the airborne software and thus could insert an error.
source_document: KB 2/USA/DO-178C Software Considerations in Airborne Systems.pdf

name: Criteria 2
text: A tool that automates verification processes and thus could fail to detect an error, and whose output is used to justify the elimination or reduction of: Verification processes other than that automated by the tool, or Development processes that could have an impact on the airborne software.
source_document: KB 2/USA/DO-178C Software Considerations in Airborne Systems.pdf

name: Criteria 3
text: A tool that, within the scope of its intended use, could fail to detect an error.
source_document: KB 2/USA/DO-178C Software Considerations in Airborne Systems.pdf
